allow_abstention.description: When true, players may vote ABSTAIN in addition to YES and NO. Unanimous voting passes when no player votes NO (ABSTAIN is neutral). Majority voting counts only non-abstaining players in the denominator. When false, only YES and NO are valid options and unanimous requires all YES votes.

majority_after_loops.description: Number of complete game loops (each player takes one turn) after which vote_mode automatically switches from 'unanimous' to 'majority'. Once triggered, this flag resets to null. Set to null to disable automatic switching.

transmute_immutable_vote_mode.description: Voting mode applied when a TRANSMUTE proposal would flip an IMMUTABLE rule to MUTABLE (per Rule 109). When null, the regular vote_mode is used. Has no effect on TRANSMUTE proposals that flip MUTABLE rules to IMMUTABLE.

vote_mode.description: Determines voting threshold. 'unanimous' requires all YES votes. 'majority' requires >50% YES votes.
